base.note: The project ships a real six-step surface scale; this ramp is that scale, not a synthesized one.

brand.purpose: Identity moments and notification titles only. Zen Dots is never used for running copy.

heading.purpose: Page titles and section headings in Goldman.

control.purpose: Buttons, toolbar actions, and status badges. Resolves to Exo 2 at weight 600 via --xy-font-control, not to Goldman.

body.purpose: General product content, capped around 65-75 characters where prose appears.

body-sm.purpose: Dense UI copy and helper text at dashboard density.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, helper text, and table metadata.

micro.purpose: Dense metric labels, overlines, and fine print. The smallest step in the system.

mono.purpose: Console output, paths, IDs, ports, versions, and metrics; anything compared character by character.

shadows.name: sticky-lg
shadows.purpose: Sticky headers separating from scrolled content.

motion.name: ease-emphasized
motion.purpose: Entrances and expressive transitions that need a longer settle.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Hover and focus feedback on controls.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Panel, drawer, and surface state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion contract implemented in design-tokens.css. Preserve it in every new surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next most important action on a screen. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--xy-primary); color: var(--xy-text-on-dark); font-family: var(--xy-font-control); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-base); font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; min-height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: var(--xy-radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--xy-transition-fast); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--xy-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--xy-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--xy-primary-darker); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions that sit beside a primary without competing with it.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--xy-surface-2); color: var(--xy-text-primary); font-family: var(--xy-font-control); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-base); font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--xy-border); border-radius: var(--xy-radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--xy-transition-fast), border-color var(--xy-transition-fast); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--xy-surface-3); border-color: var(--xy-border-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--xy-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact field with an explicit label and consequence-bearing helper text.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--xy-space-xs); } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--xy-font-body); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--xy-field-label-color); } .ds-input { background: var(--xy-surface-0); color: var(--xy-text-primary); font-family: var(--xy-font-body); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-sm); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--xy-border); border-radius: var(--xy-radius-md); transition: border-color var(--xy-transition-fast); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--xy-border-hover); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--xy-border-active); } .ds-field-helper { font-family: var(--xy-font-body); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-xs); color: var(--xy-field-helper-color); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: For repeated items, modals, and genuinely framed tools. Never nested.
components.html:
Palworld — survival-01
Node: edge-02 · Port: 8211
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--xy-surface-1); color: var(--xy-text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--xy-border); border-radius: var(--xy-radius-lg); padding: var(--xy-space-md); transition: border-color var(--xy-transition-fast); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--xy-border-hover); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--xy-font-heading); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-lg); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin-bottom: var(--xy-space-xs); } .ds-card-meta { font-family: var(--xy-font-mono); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-xs); color: var(--xy-text-secondary); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Signature component. Server lifecycle state as a pill: colored dot plus text label, so status never depends on color alone. The online dot pulses; the animation is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--xy-space-xs); font-family: var(--xy-font-control); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: var(--xy-space-xs) var(--xy-space-sm); border-radius: var(--xy-radius-pill); border: 1px solid; } .ds-dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-badge-success { background-color: var(--xy-success-bg); border-color: var(--xy-success-border); color: var(--xy-success); } .ds-dot-success { background-color: var(--xy-success); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--xy-success); animation: ds-pulse-success 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-success { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--xy-success); } 50% { opacity: 0.7; box-shadow: 0 0 2px var(--xy-success); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot-success { animation: none; } }

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Fixed 50px command band. Active navigation carries Signal Cyan.
components.html:
XYLONA
ConsoleFilesBackups
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--xy-space-lg); height: 50px; padding: 0 var(--xy-space-md); background: var(--xy-surface-2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--xy-border); } .ds-toolbar-brand { font-family: var(--xy-font-brand); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-base); color: var(--xy-text-primary); } .ds-toolbar-nav { display: flex; gap: var(--xy-space-md); } .ds-toolbar-link { font-family: var(--xy-font-heading); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-sm); color: var(--xy-text-secondary); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--xy-transition-fast); } .ds-toolbar-link:hover { color: var(--xy-text-primary); } .ds-toolbar-link-active { color: var(--xy-accent); }

components.name: Console
components.description: Signature surface. Sits at the system's darkest level so output reads as a distinct plane from the app chrome. Monospaced, stable dimensions, no layout shift.
components.html:
12:04:11 Server started on port 8211
12:04:12 World autosave disabled
components.css: .ds-console { background: var(--xy-base); color: var(--xy-text-primary); font-family: var(--xy-font-mono); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-sm); line-height: 1.45; padding: var(--xy-space-md); border: 1px solid var(--xy-border); border-radius: var(--xy-radius-md); overflow-x: auto; } .ds-console-line { white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-console-ts { color: var(--xy-text-muted); } .ds-console-warn { color: var(--xy-syntax-amber); }

components.name: Section Overline
components.description: Uppercase micro label that separates layout bands without turning them into cards.
components.css: .ds-overline { font-family: var(--xy-font-body); font-size: var(--xy-font-size-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--xy-text-muted); }

narrative.overview:
Xylona is a dark-only product UI with a futuristic command-center feel. It should communicate operational control, server health, and technical confidence while staying approachable for self-hosters.

The visual language is layered, cool-tinted, and precise: near-black foundations, stacked surfaces, cyan and blue accents, readable status colors, and restrained sci-fi typography. The product should feel immersive without sacrificing speed, scanability, or workflow clarity.

The personality is powerful, sleek, and futuristic — a high-tech command center that is confident, technical, and in control. The tone can be gaming-native and energetic, but it must never become chaotic, toy-like, or cute. Xylona should feel at home beside Discord and Steam for audience familiarity, while matching the polish and clarity users expect from tools like Linear and Vercel.
keyCharacteristics: Depth by stacked surfaces first, borders second, shadows last.
Cyan and blue reserved for interactive and stateful meaning.
Dense but legible; built for scanning and comparison.
Display typefaces for identity and command, never for dense operational content.

rules.name: The Signal Reserve Rule
rules.body: Cyan and blue carry interactive or stateful meaning. A surface that spends accent color on decoration has spent the signal, and the next genuinely stateful element has nothing left to say.

rules.name: The Never-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: The floor is --xy-base (#0D0E0F), never #000. Neutrals stay cool-tinted; a warm or fully desaturated gray reads as a different product.

rules.name: The Series-Is-Not-Status Rule
rules.body: Time-series data uses --xy-series-*, not --xy-chart-3 / --xy-chart-4. Red and amber are reserved for real state — threshold breaches and configured-limit lines — so an ordinary series like storage growth never plots in alarm colors.

rules.name: The Display Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Zen Dots and Goldman lose legibility below roughly 0.95rem. Caption and micro text is always Exo 2 or JetBrains Mono — never a display face.

rules.name: The Two-Steps-Below Rule
rules.body: Below body-sm (0.875rem) there are exactly two steps: caption (--xy-font-size-xs, 0.75rem) and micro (--xy-font-size-2xs, 0.6875rem). Do not freelance a size in between.

rules.name: The Comparable-Data Rule
rules.body: Anything an operator may need to compare character by character — ports, IDs, hashes, versions, paths, metric values — is JetBrains Mono. Proportional digits in a column of numbers are a defect, not a style choice.

rules.name: The No-Hero Rule
rules.body: Landing-page composition does not belong inside the app. Dashboards lead with state, not with a decorative hero band.

rules.name: The Functional Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows communicate layering, never gloss. If a shadow is not separating one plane from another, remove it.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism and heavy backdrop blur are not a default treatment in this system.

rules.name: The Token Radius Rule
rules.body: Always use --xy-radius-*. A literal 1rem or 999px in a component is a defect.

rules.name: The Pill-Means-Badge Rule
rules.body: Pill radius is semantic, not stylistic. If the element is not a badge, chip, status dot, or segmented control, it does not get a pill.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards do not nest. A card inside a card means the outer container should have been an unframed layout band.

rules.name: The Single Primary Rule
rules.body: One primary button per screen. If two actions both look primary, neither is.

rules.name: The Status-Never-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status pairs color with text, icon, shape, or position. A green dot alone is not a running state.

dos: Do use existing --xy-* tokens before adding new values.
Do extend design-tokens.css for utilities and overrides.css for Quasar component styling.
Do keep the app dark-only, layered, and cool-tinted.
Do make status, feedback, and available actions obvious.
Do use cyan and blue accents for interactive or stateful meaning.
Do preserve the global reduced-motion block in design-tokens.css, and animate transform and opacity rather than layout properties.
Do use --xy-ease-standard (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)) and the --xy-transition-fast / --xy-transition-base tokens for state changes.
donts: Don't hardcode colors, radii, or type sizes in components.
Don't create generic admin-template screens or cPanel-style clutter.
Don't use decorative side-stripe borders, gradient text, default glassmorphism, or repeated icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't hide server lifecycle actions, health, or errors behind vague menus.
Don't set display faces (Zen Dots, Goldman) below roughly 0.95rem.
Don't replace accepted v-html console and tooltip rendering unless the trust model changes.
Don't add durable project documentation under the repo-root /docs/, which is intentionally local scratch space.
